rationale: The answer correctly anchors CAPEC-513, lists its 52 member attack patterns, and states all 17 expected ATT&CK techniques including T1036.003, T1078, T1110, T1134, T1195, T1217, T1491, T1498.001, T1499, T1499.003, T1499.004, T1528, T1539, T1548, T1557, T1592, and T1595. It is therefore complete on the gold identifiers, but it does not cleanly map every one of the 52 CAPEC patterns to ATT&CK techniques and includes a contradictory abstention saying CAPEC-513 has no linked attack patterns. It also labels non-ATT&CK entries such as WASC:45 and OWASP Attacks:Code Injection as ATT&CK mappings, which reduces faithfulness.
